description: Na₂Zn(SnS₃)₂ is Chalcostibite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-2.96 Å. Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.38 Å) Zn-S bond lengths. Sn is bonded to four S atoms to form SnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnS₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-S bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.48 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one Sn atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sn atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one Sn atom to form corner-sharing SNa₂ZnSn tetrahedra.
